company.name: Front
company.shortDescription: Front is a AI powered customer communication platform that centralizes email, chat, and messages for team collaboration.
company.description: Front is the AI-powered customer operations platform helping businesses transform how they serve customers. By keeping humans in control of AI, Front makes sure every interaction, whether handled by automation, a human, or both, meets the highest standards of speed and quality. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front to deliver exceptional service, streamline teamwork, and gain insights that fuel growth.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $65,000,000, or 31.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,652,975 to $1,700,000,000, a 255.52x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
